author: vW4n
content: Rewrote against proto_blue::repo::Repo. Signer changed from FnOnce closure to Arc<dyn proto_blue::crypto::Signer>. Flow: validate, precompute record CIDs via cid_for_lex (match proto-blue block CIDs by construction), drive Repo::load|create + apply_writes in spawn_blocking, write per-record metadata, emit CAR. get/list decode via lex_cbor->lex_to_json. Migration note: pre-existing repos lacking persisted MST nodes will fail Repo::load.
